Mod.Name: PSX Triad HD Restoration
Mod.Author: YoRHa Numberless
Mod.Description:
PSX TRIAD HD RESTORATION Fully replaces the Triple Triad textures with a faithful, high-definition recreation of the original PSX design.
► CARD DESIGN All 110 cards artwork and layout faithful to the original PSX version.
► NUMBERS AND CHARACTERS Card power numbering, score, affinity bonus and typeface restored.
► ELEMENTAL ICONS Fire, Ice, Thunder, Wind, Earth, Water, Poison and Holy, recreated in good quality.
► GAME BOARD AND PLAYMAT Challenging screen, grid and background also reworked.
► CARDS BACK AND FRAME PSX-style card back design and frames with their decorative elements and shape.
► MATCH BANNERS Match banners (You Win!, You Lose, Draw, Same!, Plus! and Combo!) restored in high definition and translated into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Japanese.
► WIDESCREEN 16:9 and 16:10 widescreen compatibility, without black bars. It works automatically when the game runs in true 16:9 or true 16:10 (FFNx 1.25.0 or newer).
► BILINEAR FILTER At the moment, enabling the Bilinear Filter in FFNx causes texture alignment issues that also affect PSX Triad HD Restoration, with inconsistencies in borders, Frames, corners and the position of Numbers. Keep it disabled.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: —1.0 (2026-07-23): Initial release for FFVIII Remastered. —1.1 (2026-07-28): Several pose, color and resolution corrections and adjustments for accuracy purposes. Some models reworked. —1.2 (2026-07-31): Abadon Card tweaked. Elemental Icons reworked. Power value Numbers adjusted. General alignment corrections. Junction VIII version released. —1.3 (2026-10-26): Added options to choose between Original HD and Modern styles for the Frames, Cards' Back and Numbers, independently. Minor corrections in some Designs (including Abadon Card once again, as reported by Hellboy12345 on Nexus Mods), Frames, size and position. Compatible with both Remastered and Non-Remastered through Junction VIII. —1.4 (2026-11-04): Added the Clean style to the Power Numbering Style option. Added a Language option to choose the language of the textures. Modern style reworked for both Frames and Cards' Back. Modern Frames removed for regular Enemies and Bosses, as they deviated too much from the original game design. Fixed the Draw and Lose banners in Triple Triad appearing semi-transparent. Corrections in the Torama, Wedge-Biggs, Fujin-Raijin and Funguar Cards. Added 16:9 and 16:10 widescreen compatibility. Reorganized the mod folders to avoid duplicated files and make the mod lighter.
